import asyncio


# CASE g_comment_inside_gather_call expect=pass
async def map_with_concurrency[T](items: list[T], width: int, operation) -> None:
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
        await asyncio.gather(
            # one barrier per chunk
            *(operation(item) for item in items[offset : offset + width])
        )


# CASE g_comment_inside_create_task expect=pass
async def map_with_concurrency[T](items: list[T], width: int, operation) -> None:
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
        async with asyncio.TaskGroup() as group:
            for item in items[offset : offset + width]:
                group.create_task(
                    # each item joins this chunk
                    operation(item)
                )


# CASE g_comment_in_params expect=pass
async def map_with_concurrency[T](
    items: list[T],  # source rows
    width: int,  # chunk size
    operation,
) -> None:
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
        await asyncio.gather(*(operation(item) for item in items[offset : offset + width]))


# CASE g_apostrophe_comment_in_params expect=pass
async def map_with_concurrency[T](
    items: list[T],  # can't be a generator
    width: int,
    operation,
) -> None:
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
        await asyncio.gather(*(operation(item) for item in items[offset : offset + width]))


# CASE g_apostrophe_comment_in_body expect=pass
async def map_with_concurrency[T](items: list[T], width: int, operation) -> None:
    # don't start the next chunk until this one ends
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
        await asyncio.gather(*(operation(item) for item in items[offset : offset + width]))


# CASE g_comment_then_extra_await expect=fire
async def map_with_concurrency[T](items: list[T], width: int, operation) -> None:
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
        await asyncio.gather(*(operation(item) for item in items[offset : offset + width]))
        # report progress after each chunk
        await report(offset)


# CASE g_comment_column_zero_then_extra expect=fire
async def map_with_concurrency[T](items: list[T], width: int, operation) -> None:
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
        await asyncio.gather(*(operation(item) for item in items[offset : offset + width]))
# progress
        await report(offset)


# CASE g_trailing_comment_extra_after_loop expect=fire
async def map_with_concurrency[T](items: list[T], width: int, operation) -> None:
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):  # chunks
        await asyncio.gather(*(operation(item) for item in items[offset : offset + width]))  # join
    # then flush
    for item in items:
        await flush(item)


async def report(offset):
    return offset


async def flush(item):
    return item
